episodeTitle.en: The full-stack PM | Anuj Rathi (Swiggy, Jupiter Money, Flipkart)
episodeTitle.zh: 全栈产品经理 | 阿努吉·拉蒂（曾就职于Swiggy、Jupiter Money、Flipkart）

guestBioOfficial.en: Anuj Rathi is the Chief Product and Marketing Officer at Jupiter Money, where he leads product management, marketing, design, growth, and analytics. Before Jupiter Money, Anuj served as the Senior Vice President of Revenue and Growth at Swiggy, VP of Product at SnapDeal, a senior PM at Walmart Labs, and the first-ever PM at Flipkart. He’s also one of the most beloved and respected product leaders in India. In this episode, we discuss: • How product management is different in India
guestBioOfficial.zh: 阿努吉·拉蒂（Anuj Rathi）现任Jupiter Money首席产品与营销官，负责产品管理、市场营销、设计、增长和分析等领域。在加入Jupiter Money之前，阿努吉曾担任Swiggy收入与增长高级副总裁、SnapDeal产品副总裁、沃尔玛实验室高级产品经理，以及Flipkart首位产品经理。他也是印度最受尊敬和喜爱的产品领导者之一。在本期节目中，我们将探讨： • 印度产品管理的独特之处

title.en: The full-stack PM | Anuj Rathi (Swiggy, Jupiter Money, Flipkart)
title.zh: 全栈产品经理 | 阿努吉·拉蒂（曾就职于Swiggy、Jupiter Money、Flipkart）

summary.en: Anuj explains how product management differs in India and shares lessons on building product experiences for new-to-internet users at massive scale. He describes operationalizing Amazon's “working backwards” process and why he pushes teams to explore three divergent directions before settling on a plan. The conversation also covers why PMs and companies should be far more full-stack than they typically are.
summary.zh: Anuj 解释了印度市场的产品管理有何不同，并分享了为海量“新上网用户”打造产品体验的心得。他讲述了如何将亚马逊的“逆向工作法”落地，以及为何他推动团队在定案前先探索三个截然不同的方向。对话还涵盖为何产品经理和公司应当比现在更“全栈”。
